classification_reasons: Spec is tight (R1-R16 measurable, both flagged concerns closed by panel #1 and #2), but the blast radius is not small: a new name in the public app.backtest.__all__, a new CLI entry point that reaches the network and the on-disk cache through load_klines, two new modules and two new test files.
The change edits a test file already on main (tests/test_backtest.py::test_public_api, one line), a recorded departure from spec R14 and the intent's Constraints; that alone takes it out of routine.
The new code is covered only by the 19 new tests, not by tests that existed before the change.
attempted: Intent: the diff delivers `python -m app.backtest run SYMBOL INTERVAL START END [--market] [--fast 20] [--slow 50] [--fee] [--cache-dir]`, the public sma_cross_positions next to the engine, the eight-line output with the buy-and-hold line, and every refusal the intent lists. Nothing out of scope (second strategy, shorts, saved output, trade list) was added. Not a quick intent.

Spec and plan: the source and test files in the diff (app/backtest/__init__.py, __main__.py, strategy.py, tests/test_backtest.py, test_backtest_cli.py, test_strategies.py) are exactly plan.md's 'Files that change'. The check order in _run matches spec Design (make_request, lengths, fee, load_klines, height <= slow, strategy, buy-and-hold). R11's layout f"{label:<14}{value:>8}" is used. Since the build gate (head 86a123a) only evidence and status files changed, so the test phase adds no new source or test code. No concern is left open.

Build departure tests/test_backtest.py: one name added to the exact __all__ set. The equality stays exact and every other assertion is unchanged, so nothing is weakened. change_type is feature, so REVIEW.md's test-lock rule does not apply. plan.md records the departure, why it was needed (R1/Acceptance contradict R14) and how to revert it. It is left to the owner at merge, not a park.

Proof: test.log, build.log and lint.log carry the 'deferred to the runner' first line and verifier.md says 'read, not run' (CI session). Per the brief this is neither missing proof nor a claim; it is left to the runner. gate-build.json shows 193 passed and lists both new test modules (23 + 18 dots), which matches the 10 + 8 Proof names plus the parametrised cases and test_run_reports_unusable_cache_dir. verifier.md exercised the changed behaviour directly: the eight-line output, the 23/24 boundary, fee refusals with no fetch, cache reuse, help screens, and app.data download/cache-info as neighbouring flows.

Tests vs bugs: a part-filled window or min_samples < length fails test_warm_up_rows_are_flat. '>=' instead of '>' fails test_equal_smas_give_flat (exact integer ties). Any lookahead (shift(-1), centred window) fails test_positions_ignore_later_closes for every k. The engine handoff is pinned by a hand-computed -0.5 return with the fill shifted to the next open ([0,0,0,1,1,0,0]). The CLI success test derives its numbers from the same functions, but it also pins the literal header and the 22-character line widths, and the verifier's independent run backs the numbers. The fee refusals assert calls == [] (panel #1). The boundary test pins height <= slow (panel #2).

Claims against today's code: inputs._check_fee exists at app/backtest/inputs.py:41, returns float, and refuses non-numbers and anything outside 0 <= fee < 1 (so nan is refused) with 'fee X is out of range: it must be at least 0 and below 1', which is the message the tests expect. DEFAULT_FEE = 0.001. BacktestInputError subclasses ValueError and is caught explicitly in main. The CLI imports loader as a module, so the clock fixture's monkeypatch of utc_now applies.

Blast radius: app/data/, engine.py, inputs.py, summary.py, app/__init__.py, pyproject.toml, ci.yml, conftest, kucoin_stub and fixtures are untouched. The only existing production file edited is app/backtest/__init__.py (import, __all__, docstring), and strategy imports only inputs, so there is no import cycle. No guardrail file is in the diff. Risk-list hits: none, so no brief was written.

Policies: security-baseline rule 2 holds: every argument is checked before use and before any fetch; there is no eval, exec, pickle or shell, and the only network path is load_klines's existing one. ux-and-brand: one 'error:' line on stderr, exit 2, no stack trace (from None on the conversions), the note and help are module constants. coding-standards: type hints on public functions, one module per job, no new dependency. CLAUDE.md is now outdated (opening paragraph, app/backtest/ bullet); plan.md names the lines for the owner, as the intent asks.

Edge cases read: int() accepts ' 3' or '+3', which is harmless. '--fee 0.999999' prints 'fee 100.00%' because of two-decimal rounding, which R11 specifies (cosmetic). NaN closes cannot reach a trade through the CLI because run_backtest's price check refuses non-finite prices. An empty frame is refused by height <= slow before the strategy runs.
Skip markers: none added. Neither new test file has pytest.mark.skip, skipif or xfail, and gate-build ratchets details.skip_markers is []. Nothing to declare.
Drive: not applicable; commands.drive has no target here (gate proof check: 'no drive target') and the plan lists no drive files.
